Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a premium Chinese fantasy action game VFX concept approval sheet for SSLM, NOT an engine screenshot. Reference image is ONLY the mannequin identity and restrained body proportions, NOT its weak current effects or poor dark lighting. Create a polished widescreen 16:9 concept sheet. Layout: main character render occupies the left 68%, a large sharply resolved single palm close-up occupies the right 32%, separated by clean subtle spacing, not a dense technical schematic. Matte neutral blue-gray stone courtyard, soft daylight, quiet uncluttered background, fixed exposure, realistic rendered materials, no film grain. White-gray faceless articulated mannequin seen from frontal three-quarter camera at chest height, head through knees visible, both elbows slightly bent, BOTH palms turned UP and held at waist/lower chest height 55cm apart, fingers naturally separated and visible, same pose for the fire and ice pair. A compact effect is anchored to EACH palm, never floating between the hands. Hands and character upper body remain legible; clear silhouettes and ample negative space. The right close-up enlarges exactly the same design and shows readable layering. Achievable layered real-time game VFX visual language, exquisitely controlled bloom, substantial 3D volume, luminous inner details, professional AAA concept quality. Very sparse tasteful Chinese text only: title at upper left, small '设计概念图 · 待人工审核' at bottom. No node graphs, no performance claims, no UI HUD, no arrows, no logos, no fake UE screenshot label.
Title exactly: '火系掌心 · 赤金焰核'. Design two self-contained palm flames, each overall about 20cm wide and 28cm tall, spanning about two palm widths. Tiny platinum-white high-temperature seed 4cm across suspended 2cm above each palm, white highlights confined to less than 10 percent of the effect. Main body substantial honey-gold and orange-gold semi-transparent rolling fire lobes, several broad curved sheets wrapping upward around the seed with visible overlap, inner dark orange pockets and flowing luminous veins. Outer layer sculptural deep vermilion-orange tongues based on #F16B46, curling inward in elegant natural Chinese cloud-like eddies; these are fluid flame folds, not drawn decorative symbols. Feathered edges, fine wispy tips subordinate to the broad flame mass, very few embers. Subtle localized heat-haze refracting only the background beside the flames. Warm light softly touches the fingers and forearms, not the whole frame. The palms are gathering energy in place, no large central fireball, no connecting beams, no rings or magic circles. Avoid thin noodle trails, sparse flat cards, hard outlines, huge white bloom blobs, giant bonfire, covering the wrists or chest. Close-up must clearly resolve the small hot seed, thick overlapping rolling flame body, orange-red outer curling tips and subtle thermal distortion.

Title exactly: '冰系掌心 · 霜蓝晶核'. Design two self-contained palm frost formations, each overall about 20cm wide and 24cm tall, spanning about two palm widths. A compact luminous pale ice-blue rounded faceted crystal seed 6cm across hovers 2cm above each palm. Inner light small and pearly white-blue; the main crystal volume distinctly blue-cyan (#409CE5 family), visibly translucent with internal scattering, smooth refraction and layered inner planes. Six to eight curved thin translucent crystal petals/slivers gently spiral and lean around the seed forming a loose cupped crown, not a jagged rock or massive solid ice boulder; graduated sizes, crisp broad edges, softened luminous interior. Give the formation a clearly visible pale-blue outer silhouette even against a medium gray background. Low dense soft milky frost mist rolls closely around the lower half and slowly spills just beyond the fingers; keep the upper crystal structure uncovered and fingers readable. A few tiny ice motes and gentle curved cold-air refraction near the outer contour, no electric lightning. Cool reflected blue light on the fingers, local only. It must look like cold condensed magic and glassy crystalline ice, physically distinct from the fire concept, NOT blue fire, NOT an opaque stone, NOT a spiky snowflake icon. No large central orb, no connecting beams, no magic circles or flat circular halos. Avoid near-invisible low opacity, uniform cyan fog blobs, dense glitter, frost obscuring character. Close-up must show luminous inner seed, layered translucent crystal crown, soft readable frost mist and restrained air distortion.
